About

I lead the battery systems team at Voltmere. We design containerized storage for regional grids, from cell selection and thermal modeling to the controls that decide when a site charges. Before Voltmere I spent six years at Kalder Power commissioning substations across the Benelux, which taught me that the hard part of storage is the interconnection paperwork, not the chemistry. I care about safety cases that operators can read, about firmware that fails closed, and about mentoring engineers who move from automotive into grid work. Outside work I coach a youth rowing team and write about long duration storage. I lead the battery systems team at Voltmere.
